title: Pan-Seared Pork Schnitzel
description: Crispy German-style pork schnitzel cooked to perfection in a warm skillet. A delicious and satisfying meal for any occasion.
instructions: 1. Season the pork cutlets with salt and pepper.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together flour, eggs, and panko breadcrumbs.
3. Dip each pork cutlet in the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
4. Heat the skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add the coated pork cutlets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
6. Remove the pork from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the pan-seared pork schnitzel hot with lemon wedges on the side.
8. Enjoy your delicious German-style pork schnitzel!
